overview: The Medford Historical Commission approved lifting the demolition delay on 110 Brooks Street and voted to submit no comment on a Section 106 wireless facility review. The commission also reviewed Reading's preservation zoning ordinance as a potential local model and received updates on ongoing cemetery, survey, and Brooks Estate projects.

items.title: 110 Brooks Street Demolition Delay
items.summary: Approved lifting the demolition delay subject to revised design plans submitted to the building department.

items.title: 20 Harvard Avenue Section 106 Review
items.summary: Voted to submit no comment regarding proposed cellular tower alterations at the property.

items.title: Preservation Ordinance Discussion
items.summary: Discussed Reading's historic preservation zoning relief ordinance and agreed to review the model over the next 30 days and seek a meeting with Reading officials.

items.title: Commission Officer Positions and Succession
items.summary: Discussed officer assignments for 2025, committee appointments, and recruitment to prepare for upcoming board vacancies.

items.title: Demolition Delay Status Updates
items.summary: Scheduled a subcommittee design review meeting with an applicant and discussed contacting the owners of 27 Street to request concrete architectural plans.

items.title: Surveys, Cemetery, and Grant Updates
items.summary: Received updates on Form B survey funding, the Cross Street Cemetery assessment and archaeological investigation, and bids for the Sagamore Vale survey.

items.title: Brooks Estate Update
items.summary: Heard updates on Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust operations, manor parking and maintenance challenges, and recruitment needs for landscape and preservation specialists.
